title: Confirm purposes and two-entity working structure
acceptance: Decision record names the proposed structure, purposes and open ownership choices.

title: Agree cultural decision and permission process
acceptance: Relevant cultural decision holders determine the process and approved public terminology.

title: Record native title claim, site boundaries and access evidence
acceptance: Native title claim records, mapped area, cultural permissions and access evidence are indexed; outstanding questions are visible.

title: Choose not-for-profit membership and director rules
acceptance: Founders settle eligible membership, board composition and cultural governance interface.

title: Prepare ORIC not-for-profit rule book
acceptance: Tailored version includes not-for-profit/winding-up clauses and clause-to-source review.

title: Collect private membership consents
acceptance: Consent and eligibility recorded privately; current membership requirements verified.

title: Prepare private director consents and eligibility records
acceptance: Officeholder eligibility checked per selected structure; director ID tasks recorded where applicable.

title: Choose share ownership, votes and durable control
acceptance: Cap table and dilution/transfer tests preserve the agreed Indigenous majority.

title: Draft commercial constitution
acceptance: Share rights and board rules align with the control schedule.

title: Draft shareholders agreement
acceptance: Reserved matters, transfers, dilution, deadlock and exits are reviewed together.

title: Assemble review pack and ask about QYAC-assisted review
acceptance: Proposed reviewer scope and availability confirmed before treating review as agreed.

title: Resolve rule book and company document comments
acceptance: Each comment has a recorded response and decision owner.

title: Hold founding ORIC meeting or circulating consent process
acceptance: Actual votes and required pre-incorporation evidence recorded against current ORIC requirements.

title: Lodge ORIC application and record determination
acceptance: Lodgement receipt retained; registration only marked complete on certificate and approved rule book.

title: Complete registered office, shares and ASIC registration inputs
acceptance: Private consents, share inputs and current fee captured.

title: Register commercial company and issue initial shares
acceptance: Certificate, register, issued shares and first board resolutions match the agreed structure.

title: Assess charity eligibility and DGR separately
acceptance: Purpose/public benefit review identifies applicable pathway without assuming endorsement.

title: Apply for ABNs, TFNs and relevant tax registrations
acceptance: Each entity records completed registrations and tax obligations based on actual activities.

title: Draft inter-entity responsibilities and community benefit terms
acceptance: Each entity retains its duties; related-party terms and community benefit mechanism are clear.

title: Confirm Ready S.E.T. Co-op legal identity and service scope
acceptance: Actual provider, employer and training responsibilities confirmed before execution.

title: Draft administration, employment and training service agreement
acceptance: Service levels, fees, delegations, privacy and training provider arrangements are reviewable.

title: Adopt conflict, related-party and delegation policy
acceptance: Recusal, approval and spending delegations adopted by the competent boards.

title: Open separate bank accounts and appoint signatories
acceptance: Accounts and signatories independently resolved for each entity.

title: Set up chart of accounts, payroll and monthly close in-house
acceptance: Cash and restricted funds separated; payroll and inter-entity reconciliation documented.

title: Build regulator and operating compliance calendar
acceptance: Entity-specific due dates verified against notices and registrations.

title: Check current zoning, overlays and existing approvals
acceptance: Parcel-specific records include version/date and original approvals conditions.

title: Describe permanent living day activities residencies and short stays separately
acceptance: Each use category has its own numbers durations facilities and works description; permanent living remains part of the project.

title: Request Council pre-lodgement guidance against the parcel
acceptance: Written assessment pathway and information requests added to approvals matrix.

title: Screen SARA state referral triggers
acceptance: State-interest screening records source and competent assessment of triggers.

title: Confirm cultural heritage process for site activities
acceptance: Appropriate cultural and statutory process recorded before disturbance.

title: Screen national environmental matters and referral need
acceptance: Protected-matters screening and impact questions referred for competent assessment.

title: Check survey, access, fire, water and wastewater capacity
acceptance: On-ground evidence replaces concept assumptions; investigation costs quoted as needed.

title: Define staged infrastructure and development application scope
acceptance: The chosen stage integrates site layout modular or visitor places shared services and cultural direction with relevant evidence.

title: Prepare and lodge required development/works applications
acceptance: Relevant applications lodged by authorised parties; conditions and decisions tracked individually.

title: Select culturally approved pilot experiences
acceptance: Hosts, offerings, group size and cultural permissions agreed.

title: Collect evidence of cultural activity demand and pricing
acceptance: Demand, comparable offers and price assumptions have sources and dates.

title: Draft cultural activities business plan
acceptance: Session costs, host pay, weather fallback and cash margin shown without speculative uptake.

title: Define accommodation types, durations and lawful capacity
acceptance: Capacity and stay types trace to approvals/investigations rather than the rough concept map.

title: Collect accommodation demand and full operating cost inputs
acceptance: Occupancy, rates, cleaning, staffing, freight, utilities and maintenance assumptions labelled.

title: Draft temporary accommodation and residency business plan
acceptance: Base/low/high cases and staged inventory avoid double-counting activity income.

title: Build cash scenarios and funding-gap register
acceptance: Monthly cash and actual on-costs separated by entity; no C-Hour valuation or grant assumed secured.

title: Prepare visitor terms and operating handbook
acceptance: Bookings, refunds, conduct, amenities and complaints matched to actual stage.

title: Prepare emergency plan, risk register and insurance scope
acceptance: Coverage and emergency access match actual activities, guests and accommodation.

title: Prepare paid roles, volunteering boundaries and training plan
acceptance: Employer responsibilities and current worker requirements verified; volunteering never offsets wages.

title: Agree media, ICIP, privacy and AI permissions
acceptance: Specific permissions, withdrawal and restricted data controls recorded.

title: Create agency written-answer and follow-up register
acceptance: Each question has the relevant agency, evidence request and response status.

title: Assess funding and reusable studies without relying on grants
acceptance: Eligibility/current rounds checked; no unsourced claims about previous transition expenditure.

title: Create procurement and asset ownership register
acceptance: Asset title, restrictions, procurement approvals and maintenance owner recorded.

title: Confirm relevant permissions and operating conditions for stage one
acceptance: Evidence covers the exact first stage and its relevant site-specific briefs; later-stage works do not become blanket prerequisites.

title: Run induction, emergency drill and operating rehearsal
acceptance: Exercise findings and corrective actions recorded before board release decision.

title: Record separate day-activity and stay opening decisions
acceptance: Competent boards record actual decisions based on evidence for the authorised stage.

title: Approve a redacted public progress update
acceptance: Public status is evidence-based; personal IDs, signatures and restricted cultural records excluded.

title: Capture the original site plan and founder corrections
acceptance: Source register links every original concept section and records native title claim and non-financial C-Hour corrections.

title: Reconcile areas structure counts and flexible-place estimates
acceptance: Area calculations show rounding; 15 acres and the 13.4-acre trace stay separate; structures and pitches are not treated as people capacity.

title: Sketch culturally directed clusters and retained areas
acceptance: Layout options separate ceremony quiet living growing work and vehicle movement; restricted areas remain private.

title: Record permanent resident medium-term and short-stay needs
acceptance: Three use categories include household privacy accessibility and shared-service needs without publishing personal details.

title: Set resident allocation and occupancy arrangement questions
acceptance: Allocation choices operator responsibility and occupancy questions are recorded for review; no rights or residents are invented.

title: Draft the permanent living and residency framework
acceptance: Permanent living has its own plan rather than being folded into short-stay bookings.

title: Record existing materials structures and clean-up areas
acceptance: An authorised site walk records conditions owners access and cultural exclusions before disturbance.

title: Plan material sorting reuse storage and disposal
acceptance: Each stream has a permission handling owner storage and destination; unknown materials have a review pathway.

title: Carry out the authorised clean-up stage and record outcomes
acceptance: The agreed stage records actual permissions work undertaken items reused disposal evidence and remaining issues.

title: Record existing dwelling condition and shared-use options
acceptance: Current occupant preferences remain private; retain repair repurpose and defer options are documented.

title: Plan the replacement-home and dwelling transition sequence
acceptance: Replacement suitability services permissions and accommodation continuity precede any proposed move.

title: Record a dwelling transition decision and handover conditions
acceptance: Authorised decision names the chosen option evidence conditions and responsible people without assuming displacement.

title: Match expandable buildings and containers to actual uses
acceptance: The 20/20/30 concept mix is classified by household studio work storage or shared use; no bed count is inferred.

title: Check modular specifications delivery foundations and costs
acceptance: Supplier evidence and quotes cover dimensions ferry freight access lifting assembly foundations services and maintenance.

title: Choose a staged modular purchase hire or defer schedule
acceptance: The chosen stage has an asset owner real costs permissions and a procurement gate; full concept quantities are not an order.

title: Describe the tent van caravan bus and house-truck options
acceptance: The 40/15/10 place mix records stay type footprints shade amenities and visitor-versus-resident use.

title: Test sandy tracks turning loops and pedestrian separation
acceptance: Vehicle dimensions on-ground observations and emergency movement inform the layout; the 800 m equivalent stays an estimate.

title: Set stage-specific flexible-place capacity and arrival rules
acceptance: Capacity follows actual service and permission evidence; 65 places is not a people limit.

title: Specify shared kitchen cold storage and three amenity options
acceptance: The brief states actual household event and food-service needs and replaces area allowances with equipment and user scenarios.

title: Record kitchen design food-service and amenities responses
acceptance: Written responses address the proposed service model accessible amenities utilities and cleaning responsibilities.

title: Draft kitchen cold-chain and amenities operating routines
acceptance: Bookings cleaning cold-chain outage actions consumables staffing and maintenance are assigned for the chosen stage.

title: Define food forest orchard garden and nursery trial areas
acceptance: Cultural plant permissions soil shade and water observations inform each distinct growing area.

title: Design a Tower Farm and Seedling Hub trial beside the kitchen
acceptance: The trial records method equipment water power crop choices costs and measured learning rather than invented yields.

title: Set seasonal growing harvest and kitchen handoff routines
acceptance: Roles irrigation compost pest practices harvest and food handoff support a small documented growing stage.

title: Record cultural directions for ceremony yarning and gathering
acceptance: Relevant cultural decision holders shape uses access and sensitive areas; restricted directions stay private.

title: Plan shade access quiet separation and gathering services
acceptance: The roughly 8000 m2 concept area has a needs brief; attendance is assessed separately from area.

title: Agree gathering calendar host roles and recording permissions
acceptance: Cultural gatherings teaching and public offerings have distinct permissions host arrangements and scheduling.

title: Choose first making repair and tool-sharing activities
acceptance: A small 7-Mile workshop scope records users mentors and tools; the separate Dunwich proposal is identified.

title: Plan workshop zones storage induction and material intake
acceptance: Clean and dirty zones tool stewards borrowing and consentful material intake have practical routines.

title: Prepare a supervised repair and learning session
acceptance: The session brief names mentors permitted tools safety arrangements costs and outcome records for review before running.

title: Map separate Maker-Space Tip Loop and Capsule Surge interfaces
acceptance: The register distinguishes proposed sites operators needs and source conflicts; no partnership or co-location is asserted.

title: Prepare proposed tool material training and specialist-stay terms
acceptance: Draft interfaces identify permissions ownership transport service costs data choices and each party responsibility.

title: Record confirm defer or decline decisions for each interface
acceptance: Only actual agreements are marked confirmed; compute and health-support ideas retain separate scope decisions.

title: Build household visitor kitchen garden and workshop load scenarios
acceptance: Service demand distinguishes residents visitors food growing cold storage workshop use and optional compute.

title: Test water harvesting wastewater power and outage options
acceptance: Options record site evidence quoted services maintenance potable/non-potable separation and staged capacity.

title: Draft commons and service commissioning schedule
acceptance: Each chosen facility has a service owner commissioning evidence maintenance and an outage plan.

title: Draft everyday resident guest and host community agreements
acceptance: Welcome quiet hours shared facilities responsibilities and cultural boundaries reflect distinct resident and guest needs.

title: Set voluntary stewardship learning and contribution routines
acceptance: Paid work voluntary contribution maintenance and training remain distinct; C-Hours create no financial or occupancy entitlement.

title: Rehearse shared-life routines and review the selected stage
acceptance: A tabletop rehearsal records welcome bookings meals tools complaints maintenance and actions for the selected stage.
